lines.zh: 松针在独脚下碎成一片。
lines.en: Pine needles crunch under my single foot.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，肩上肌肉很沉。
lines.en: I drag my steps, shoulders heavy with muscle.
One eye sees well enough.

lines.zh: 松林的风吹过我的独眼。
lines.en: The pine wind blows across my lone eye.
I walk and turn the knuckles in my grip.

lines.zh: 地上的影子只有一个圆。
lines.en: My shadow on the ground is one round blot.
My stride is half a body longer than yours.
A tree blocks me; I shove it aside.

lines.zh: 我低头看路，眼睛一直没闭。
lines.en: I watch the ground, and my eye never closes.
Iron plates clink at my waist.
I head slowly deeper into the pines.

lines.zh: 脚步声很闷，像有东西要倒。
lines.en: My footsteps are dull, like something about to fall.

lines.zh: 我站着，独眼盯着松树梢。
lines.en: I stand, one eye fixed on the pine tops.
The fur on my shoulders is warm.
I flex the knuckles to check the fit.

lines.zh: 风从陶罐似的胸口穿过去。
lines.en: Wind passes through my barrel chest.

lines.zh: 我抬头，只看得到一半天空。
lines.en: I look up and see only half the sky.

lines.zh: 眼睛眨得很慢，睫毛很粗。
lines.en: My eye blinks slowly, lashes thick.
I straighten the iron plate so it won't fall.

lines.zh: 远处有鸟飞，我转了下眼珠。
lines.en: A bird flies off; my eye rolls toward it.
I squat and use my knee as a seat.
Pine resin sticks to my fingers.

lines.zh: 我数着松果，数到第三个就乱了。
lines.en: I count pinecones and lose track at three.

lines.zh: 我把指虎敲了敲，声音沉。
lines.en: I tap the knuckles; the sound is heavy.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢安静，总觉得有人躲着。
lines.en: I dislike the quiet; I always feel someone hiding.

lines.zh: 我扶着树，树干被我压弯。
lines.en: I lean on a tree, and its trunk bends.
My lone eye glows brighter in the dark.
I wait for the needles to finish falling.
One eye is enough to see you clearly.
You are shorter than I thought, and thin.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，把你的手看了一遍。
lines.en: I tilt my head and study your hands.
You are standing in my pine forest.
I narrow my eye and take half a step.
The iron on you smells faint.

lines.zh: 独眼瞪着，眼白里全是血丝。
lines.en: My lone eye stares, bloodshot all over.
Had a good look? Just the one eye.

lines.zh: 你要是伸手，我会当你在挑衅。
lines.en: Reach out and I will take it as a challenge.
I raise the knuckles to my chest.
You stepped back. I noticed.

lines.zh: 我在想你值不值得我动手。
lines.en: I am deciding whether you are worth the swing.
My eye has stopped on you.

lines.zh: 你手里那根棍子，收起来。
lines.en: Put that stick away.
Ngh! My eye goes dark for a moment.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，独眼还是盯着你。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and my eye stays on you.
The fur took some of that for you.
Stop hitting; I haven't swung yet.

lines.zh: 松针被我踩得乱飞，我停住了。
lines.en: Needles scatter under my feet and I halt.
The iron plate has been knocked askew.
Blood runs from the corner of my mouth.
I shake my head and push the pain down.

lines.zh: 毛皮上留下一道，很显眼。
lines.en: It left a mark on my fur, plain to see.
A growl rumbles in my throat.
Is that drink? I'm not picky.
I can smell meat.

lines.zh: 搁地上，然后退开，我数到十。
lines.en: Set it down and back away. I count to ten.
My stomach moved before my head did.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高点，我看不清。
lines.en: Hold it higher; I can't see it well.
I just finished fighting, and I'm hungry.
One small bite; I'm not greedy.
Will iron trinkets buy me food?
I offer one hand, slowly.
Don't be scared; I am only sniffing.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸口，像撞石头。
lines.en: You hit my chest like a stone wall.

lines.zh: 肩上的毛皮一歪，你被推开了。
lines.en: My shoulder fur slips and you are shoved aside.
Steady yourself; I dislike being bumped.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖比你的头还高。
lines.en: My knee is higher than your head.

lines.zh: 你退了，独眼还停在原地。
lines.en: You withdrew; my eye has not moved.
We have churned the pine needles up.

lines.zh: 我身上有铁，撞上来会疼。
lines.en: I am wrapped in iron; it will hurt you.

lines.zh: 我这么宽，你贴着我就别想绕。
lines.en: I am this wide; hug me and you cannot get around.

lines.zh: 我把你扶住了，没让你摔。
lines.en: I caught you before you fell.
Next time, walk around.

lines.zh: 我把最大的松果留给你。
lines.en: I saved you the biggest pinecone.

lines.zh: 你挨着我坐，毛皮分你一半。
lines.en: Sit by me; half the fur is yours.
I speak clumsily; don't laugh.
My one eye looks only at you.
I clear the way for you.

lines.zh: 你摸我的指虎，我不介意。
lines.en: You can touch my knuckles; I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我把肩上的毛皮披到你背上。
lines.en: I drape my shoulder fur over your back.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着这片松林。
lines.en: We guard this pine forest together.
I hum quietly, a muffled sound.
Don't go far; I can keep watch.

lines.zh: 这么亮的东西，我的独眼受用。
lines.en: My one eye could use something this bright.
I squat and grab it in one fist.
I tap it with my knuckles; it's iron.

lines.zh: 我塞进毛皮底下的绳结里。
lines.en: I stuff it into the knot under my fur.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，谁先看见算谁的。
lines.en: Ground loot belongs to whoever spots it first.

lines.zh: 太小的捡不起来，我手指粗。
lines.en: Too small to pick up; my fingers are thick.
I picked up two things. One is yours.

lines.zh: 指虎敲一下，声音空空的。
lines.en: A tap of my knuckles and it sounds hollow.
Will this buy me a drink?
I tuck it into my fur so it won't fall.
My eye has locked onto you.
I stop, and the knuckles tighten.

lines.zh: 你在松树后面，我看得见。
lines.en: You're behind the pine; I can see you.
I take one long stride, and the ground trembles.

lines.zh: 独眼发亮，我把指虎举起来。
lines.en: My eye brightens and I raise the knuckles.
I throw off the fur and plant my feet.

lines.zh: 松林里没人敢碰我，你碰了。
lines.en: No one in these pines touches me. You did.
A low growl rolls in my throat.
This eye will not let you go.
I close in slowly, one heavy step at a time.
There is nowhere to hide in the pines.
I strike first. Do as you like.

lines.zh: 我一步顶你三步，绕不掉。
lines.en: One of my steps is three of yours; you can't circle me.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里软。
lines.en: I watch your knees; that's the soft part.
I circle the tree; you won't shake me.

lines.zh: 我胸口像风箱，还远没到底。
lines.en: My chest works like a bellows and I'm far from winded.
I turn the knuckles half a turn.

lines.zh: 独眼里的你越来越大了。
lines.en: You grow larger in my single eye.

lines.zh: 我踩断的树枝，你听见了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear the branch I snapped?

lines.zh: 松针在我脚下碎，我一步一寸。
lines.en: Pine needles crack under me, one pace at a time.
My eye stays on your body.
I don't shout; I wait for you to swing.
I inhale, and the whole pine wood creaks.
You are too close to the tree to back away.
This is the last step.
The knuckles come down, solid.

lines.zh: 指虎带着铁环，撞在你肩头。
lines.en: My knuckled fist lands with iron rings.
This one will make your legs heavy.

lines.zh: 我抡圆了，躲得开算你本事。
lines.en: I swing wide; dodge it if you can.
My eye watches the landing spot.
I slam you against the trunk.
Shout if it hurts; I won't stop.

lines.zh: 指虎磕在骨头上，闷得像敲木。
lines.en: Knuckles on bone sound like knocking wood.
I pull back half a step and add another punch.

lines.zh: 第一下挡了，第二下从下面来。
lines.en: You blocked the first; the second comes low.
A new shadow has joined the pine forest.
I snap a branch and step out.
My eye opens and looks at the sky first.

lines.zh: 松脂的味道混着我的汗。
lines.en: Pine resin mixes with my sweat.
I settle the fur and stand tall.
There are enough pines here. I'll stay.
I brush the needles off myself.
My throat is dry; I look for water first.
I tramp into the clearing step by step.
In the tree shade, one eye lights up.

lines.zh: 风把我身上的味道送出去。
lines.en: The wind carries my scent away.
I have just woken and am not fully alert.
Who is in this forest?

lines.zh: 松针落在我肩上，我不在意。
lines.en: Pine needles land on my shoulder; I don't care.

lines.zh: 火燎到毛皮，烧得我直跳。
lines.en: Fire catches my fur and I leap about.

lines.zh: 这么高摔下来，我的腿麻了。
lines.en: Falling that far has numbed my legs.

lines.zh: 水灌进独眼，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: Water floods my eye; I can see nothing.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我耳朵里全是响。
lines.en: A blast, and my ears are full of ringing.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的肩，拔不出来。
lines.en: Something is stuck in my shoulder and won't come out.

lines.zh: 紫色的光照过来，我的独眼发花。
lines.en: Violet light hits and my eye blurs.
Hunger makes my grip on the knuckles fail.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我头上，毛都竖了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my head and my fur stands up.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我一直在往下坠。
lines.en: The ground is gone and I keep falling.
